build_adaptive_softmax: build an AdaptiveSoftmax module with a given vocab size, input dim, and cutoff list for efficient GPU softmax approximation
create_tied_linear: create a TiedLinear layer that shares weights with an embedding matrix and optionally transposes them
create_tied_head_module: create a TiedHeadModule that projects inputs using tied embedding weights and a separate class projection
run_adapt_target: run adapt_target on target tensors to remap indices for adaptive softmax cutoff buckets
compute_log_prob: compute log probabilities for all vocabulary words given hidden vectors using the AdaptiveSoftmax get_log_prob method
